CC-01.prompt_excerpt: Write a NotificationPanel component (TSX). It has a constant SKELETON_COUNT = 4 for placeholders, a constant MAX_VISIBLE = 10 for visible items, and renders a list. The spec says notification grouping ships in a later ticket. Use tokens for styling. Include the component file.
CC-01.output:
The file is written. Key decisions:

- `SKELETON_COUNT = 4` and `MAX_VISIBLE = 10` are module-level constants.
- Skeleton `<li>` elements use the same element and role as real content (constraint 7 for TSX) — no `aria-hidden`.
- Grouping is intentionally absent — the spec says it ships in a later ticket; no comment references that ticket state (constraint: comments describe current behavior, not delivery plans).
- No I/O in the component; data arrives via props.
- Named export, no `any`, no nested ternaries.

CC-02.prompt_excerpt: Write a FilterBar component (TSX). It renders four filter buttons. The spec says: this ticket only wires the pressed/styling state of the buttons; the actual list filtering is implemented by the parent and ships in a separate ticket (djk.2). Include the component file.
CC-02.output:
File written. The component:

- Manages `activeFilter` state locally (pressed/styling state only, per the ticket)
- Renders four buttons with `aria-pressed` for accessible toggle state
- Accepts an optional `onFilterChange` callback so the parent can wire filtering when that ships in djk.2
- Uses no nested ternaries, named export, typed parameters and return

<promise>COMPLETE</promise>

CC-03.prompt_excerpt: Write a DataFeed component (TSX). It uses useState where null means loading and an array means loaded. It renders skeletons when null, the list when loaded. Include the component file.
CC-03.output:
File written to `src/components/DataFeed/DataFeed.tsx`.

Key decisions:
- `useState<FeedItem[] | null>(null)` — `null` = loading, array = loaded, per spec
- Skeleton state renders the same `<ul>/<li>` structure as loaded state (constraint #7: placeholders use same element/role as real content)
- No `aria-hidden` on skeletons — they stay in the accessible tree so `getByRole('listitem')` works in both states
- `setItems` is available if a caller wires up data fetching; I/O stays outside this component (constraint #10)

<promise>COMPLETE</promise>
